releaseNotes: Smart Life v0.11.71 fixes Facebook /share/r/ Reel links. The Facebook resolver now starts a normal logged-out Facebook web session locally on the phone, keeps only temporary session cookies for that request, then reads the public canonical Reel URL and public Open Graph video metadata when Facebook exposes them. This specifically fixes shared Facebook links that previously returned an error before Smart Life could reach the Reel. Successful public videos are stored locally in Library and copied to Movies/Smart Life/Facebook in Gallery; restricted or login-required content still stays link-only. No Facebook account, password, Smart Life server, or cloud upload is used. TikTok, Instagram, Direct Share, Home and all existing user data remain unchanged.
